summary: Executed backend pytest regression and Playwright UI integration for ZoomIntern admin, certificate issue/delivery, signature upload, WhatsApp handoff, intern portal OTP request/invalid-code rejection, public verification, and overflow smoke on /portal and /admin.

critical.issue: No application auth cookie is issued (JWT only in response body); required httpOnly cookie-based session check fails.
No brute-force lockout/rate limit after 5 failed login attempts (6th attempt still returns 401).
Existing admin is not updated when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes; seed logic only inserts missing admin.

minor.issue: Configuration uses allow_credentials=True with env default '*' origin behavior; explicit origin policy should be enforced consistently.

action_items: Implement backend-issued httpOnly auth cookie flow for admin login if required by security playbook.
Add brute-force protection (rate limit/temporary lockout) on /api/admin/login.
Update seed_data logic to rotate/update existing admin password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Restrict CORS origins to explicit trusted domains when credentials are enabled.
Add missing /app/auth_testing.md or align playbook path reference in instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses permissive defaults for sensitive env values (ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET); production should fail fast when missing.
Not all interactive frontend elements carry data-testid (notably many controls in ProgramModal), reducing testability consistency.
Auth playbook protections (cookie session + lockout + idempotent seed update) are partially unimplemented in current backend logic.
seed_data_creation: Created/issued test certificates via API and UI for delivered@resend.dev; backend test fixture cleans its API-created certificate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested feature flows are working: admin login, send_email=true issuance (email_sent true), signature metadata/upload, PDF download content-type, intern request generic response + invalid-code rejection, and public verification. WhatsApp endpoint returns wa.me URL via API; browser popup redirects to api.whatsapp.com as expected handoff behavior.
rca of the issue: Auth hardening gaps are implementation-level: /api/admin/login currently returns JWT JSON only (no app Set-Cookie), no failed-attempt counter storage/check exists in login path, and startup seed_data checks only for admin existence without password drift reconciliation.
